title: Why a God Would Jump
summary: Why would anyone leap out of the sky? Tell someone what you saw, and see if it sounds as true out loud.

goals.say: 'Why would he jump?' 'To catch someone who was falling.' The elder is quiet for a long time.
goals.name: Village Elder

threats.name: Village Elder
threats.target_line: You've been dreaming again. It's all over your face.
talk: Maraal? Then he jumped after her. Gods aren't meant to do that. Maybe that's what broke him.
The fall split him in two.
The half that caught her, and the half that hated the sky for letting her go. Aye. That sounds like a god.
